formula_protocol_match.evidence: The public report_test.py and run.py implement the same success-gated OT/AT clipping formula documented by the organizers.
formula_protocol_match.reason: The 0.4762 leaderboard score was computed on 50 private evaluation worlds with 10 trials each; those worlds and the organizer-side execution trace are unavailable.

interpretation: The checked-in upstream output recomputes to 0.4889133891483272 on the public 50-world files, above the organizer's 0.4762 hidden-test leaderboard score. The public LiCS scripts use the same formula as the organizer specification, so formula/protocol equivalence is verified. The hidden final score itself is not independently reproducible because the private worlds and organizer-side trace are unavailable. Twelve logged sixth-column metrics differ because run.py uses a -2.25 m start while report_test.py recomputes OT from -2.0 m; the strict audit intentionally follows report_test.py and records the discrepancy. This verifies evaluator arithmetic and artifact consistency, not an independent rerun of the LiCS controller or an official re-ranking.
